verdict.line: You lose extended trades and solo kills before level 6 if you eat his Q-W combo and empowered autos; you win from level 9 onward once Enrage health-stacking and Heartsteel scaling outpace his sustain.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's measured lane and solo-kill edge comes from stacking damage: Q (The Darkin Blade)'s three-swing combo plus Deathbringer Stance's empowered healing auto and Umbral Dash's on-hit heal let him out-sustain Sion in prolonged trades. Sion has no comparable early sustain tool, so he has to survive on W (Death's Caress) shield absorption and let E (Enrage) health-stacking plus late Heartsteel scaling drag the matchup back to the measured 49.2% even split.

theirWindow.when: Passive charged and W (825 range) up
theirWindow.what: He's hunting an empowered auto plus an Infernal Chains pull to force a bad trade. Don't give him a free stationary target at his W max range; walk around minions instead of through them.

yourWindow.when: His W and E (dash) both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is OP.GG's own read on the matchup: Aatrox has no chain and no dash to punish an all-in. Pop E (Enrage) and go straight into Q (Cryptic Gaze) to stun and commit the full trade.

start.why: 46.2% win rate over 132 games and the 62% pick rate for a reason — the passive block and regen directly counter the poke damage from his Q swings and empowered autos that define this lane.

boots.why: 50% win rate over 144 games (72% pick). Aatrox's whole kit is auto-attack and physical-damage reliant, so flat reduction matters more than the swiftness alternative here.

core.why: Stacks max health passively on top of what Enrage already builds, directly scaling the stat that lets you out-trade him from level 9 on.
Shield-on-damage sustain to survive his Deathbringer Stance/Umbral Dash healing pattern during extended trades.

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustain on every short trade plus permanent bonus health, which stacks with Enrage's own health growth to close the gap his passive sustain opens early.

summoners.why: 86.5% pick rate at 52.7% win rate. Teleport lets you reset and keep stacking health off minions safely under turret during the levels 3-5 window where you're behind, while Flash covers the Q stun engage or an escape from a landed W chain.

playing.title: Hold W for his empowered auto
playing.detail: Don't throw Death's Caress away on chip poke. Time the shield to absorb his Deathbringer Stance-empowered auto or a Q swing, since that's where the real burst in this matchup comes from.

playing.title: Track the passive icon, not just HP
playing.detail: Deathbringer Stance charging means his next auto heals him off your max health. Watch for it and either disengage or stun it off with Q before he lands it.

playing.title: All-in only when W and E are down
playing.detail: Per the matchup read, Aatrox has no chain or dash up in that window. E (Enrage) into Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun is your full commit — he can't punish it back.

playing.title: Respect his Q range before level 6
playing.detail: The three-swing combo is where your solo-kill risk is highest. Don't extend trades past the second swing threat zone.

playing.title: Farm Enrage kills for permanent HP
playing.detail: Every minion kill while E is active adds permanent max health. Prioritize this during the levels 3-5 deficit so you're ahead on stats by level 9.

playing.title: Buy anti-heal the moment you're losing trades
playing.detail: Bramble Vest or Thornmail directly cuts the passive and E sustain that's the actual source of his lane advantage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reading of cooldown windows and trade timing is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Farm lane while being wary of his range. Engage combat with [E]-[Q] when his skills are on cooldown.
